## Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(afex)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(tibble)
library(DHARMa)
library(janitor)
library(openxlsx2)
library(papaja)

source("../_common.R")

run_model <- FALSE
load_artifacts <- !run_model
```

```{r}
df_long <- readRDS("../data/df_long.rds")
```

Variables of interest for this analysis:

-   `prolific_pid`: participant identifier
-   `structure_num`: experimental structure condition
    -   interindividual = 0
    -   intergroup = 1
-   `motivation`: experimental motivation condition
    -   prosocial
    -   proself
    -   hybrid
-   `q7_3_1` through `q7_3_10`: Church's public-letter clues (Common information)
-   `q7_4_1` through `q7_4_10`: participant-only letter clues (Unique information)
-   control variables
    -   age
    -   sex_num
    -   need_cog_mean
    -   dirty_dozen_narcissism
    -   dirty_dozen_psychopathy
    -   dirty_dozen_machiavellianism

#### Missingness

```{r}
control_missingness_participant <- df_long %>%
  distinct(
    prolific_pid,
    age,
    sex_num,
    ethnicity_simplified,
    need_cog_mean,
    dirty_dozen_narcissism,
    dirty_dozen_psychopathy,
    dirty_dozen_machiavellianism,
    cooperation_mean
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      -prolific_pid,
      list(
        missing_n = ~ sum(is.na(.)),
        missing_pct = ~ mean(is.na(.)) * 100
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("Variable", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "^(.*)_(missing_n|missing_pct)$"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing_pct))

control_missingness_participant
```

### data

```{r}
# Create data
control_data <- df_long %>%
  select(
    shared,
    info_distribution,
    info_importance,
    age,
    sex_num,
    ethnicity_simplified,
    need_cog_mean,
    dirty_dozen_narcissism,
    dirty_dozen_psychopathy,
    dirty_dozen_machiavellianism,
    prolific_pid,
    item_id
  ) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  droplevels()
```

```{r}
# Standardize continuous variables
control_data <- control_data %>%
  mutate(
    age_z = as.numeric(scale(age)),
    need_cog_z = as.numeric(scale(need_cog_mean)),
    narcissism_z = as.numeric(scale(dirty_dozen_narcissism)),
    psychopathy_z = as.numeric(scale(dirty_dozen_psychopathy)),
    machiavellianism_z = as.numeric(
      scale(dirty_dozen_machiavellianism)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
control_data %>%
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_participants = n_distinct(prolific_pid),
    n_items = n_distinct(item_id)
  )
```

### form

```{r}
#| eval: !expr run_model

if (run_model) {

model_controls <- mixed(
  shared ~
    info_distribution +
    info_importance +
    age_z +
    sex_num +
    ethnicity_simplified +
    need_cog_z +
    narcissism_z +
    psychopathy_z +
    machiavellianism_z +
    (1 | prolific_pid) +
    (1 | item_id),
  data = control_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  method = "LRT",
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)
  )
)

saveRDS(
  model_controls,
  "../artifacts/model_infosharing_controls.rds"
  )

}
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr load_artifacts

if (load_artifacts) {

model_controls <- readRDS(
  "../artifacts/model_infosharing_controls.rds"
)

}
```

#### ANOVA

```{r}
anova(model_controls)
```

```{r}
# coefficient information
coef_table <- as.data.frame(
  summary(model_controls$full_model)$coefficients
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  mutate(
    OR = exp(Estimate),
    CI_low = exp(Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`),
    CI_high = exp(Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`)
  )

coef_table
```

```{r}
control_table <- coef_table

control_table <- control_table %>%
  mutate(
    b = format_stat(Estimate),
    SE = format_stat(`Std. Error`),
    LR_chi2 = "",
    p = format_stat(`Pr(>|z|)`, p_value = TRUE),
    OR_CI = paste0(
      format_stat(OR),
      " [",
      format_stat(CI_low),
      ", ",
      format_stat(CI_high),
      "]"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Likelihood ratio tests
control_lrt <- as.data.frame(
  anova(model_controls)
)

control_lrt <- control_lrt %>%
  mutate(
    LR_chisq = format_stat(Chisq),
    p = format_stat(`Pr(>Chisq)`, p_value = TRUE)
  )

control_lrt
```

```{r}
names(control_lrt)
```

```{r}
control_table$term
```

```{r}
control_row_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~coef_term,             ~lrt_term,               ~Predictor,                  ~Section,
  "(Intercept)",          NA,                      "Intercept",                  "Intercept",
  "info_distribution1",   "info_distribution",     "Common (0) vs. Unique (1)", "Within-Participant Variables",
  "info_importance1",     "info_importance",       "Low (0) vs. High (1)",     "Within-Participant Variables",
  "age_z",                "age_z",                 "Age",                        "Control Variables",
  "sex_num",              "sex_num",               "Sex",                        "Control Variables",
  NA,                     "ethnicity_simplified",  "Ethnicity",                  "Control Variables",
  "need_cog_z",           "need_cog_z",            "Need for Cognition",         "Control Variables",
  "narcissism_z",         "narcissism_z",          "Narcissism",                 "Control Variables",
  "psychopathy_z",        "psychopathy_z",          "Psychopathy",               "Control Variables",
  "machiavellianism_z",   "machiavellianism_z",    "Machiavellianism",           "Control Variables"
)
```

```{r}
coef_for_table <- control_table %>%
  select(
    term,
    Estimate,
    `Std. Error`,
    OR,
    CI_low,
    CI_high
  )
```

```{r}
lrt_for_table <- control_lrt %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("lrt_term") %>%
  select(
    lrt_term,
    Chisq,
    `Pr(>Chisq)`
  )
```

```{r}
# join two
control_paper <- control_row_map %>%
  left_join(
    coef_for_table,
    by = c("coef_term" = "term")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    lrt_for_table,
    by = "lrt_term"
  )

control_paper
```

```{r}
control_paper <- control_paper %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate_display = format_stat(Estimate),
    
    SE_display = format_stat(`Std. Error`),
    
    LR_chisq_display = format_stat(Chisq),
    
    p_display = format_stat(
      `Pr(>Chisq)`,
      p_value = TRUE
    ),
    
    OR_CI_display = if_else(
      is.na(OR),
      "",
      paste0(
        format_stat(OR),
        " [",
        format_stat(CI_low),
        ", ",
        format_stat(CI_high),
        "]"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# no intercept for LR
control_paper <- control_paper %>%
  mutate(
    LR_chisq_display = if_else(
      Predictor == "Intercept",
      "",
      LR_chisq_display
    ),
    p_display = if_else(
      Predictor == "Intercept",
      "",
      p_display
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# select columns
control_paper <- control_paper %>%
  select(
    Section,
    Predictor,
    Estimate = Estimate_display,
    SE = SE_display,
    `LR χ²` = LR_chisq_display,
    p = p_display,
    `OR [95% CI]` = OR_CI_display
  )
```

```{r}
control_paper
```

## Full Model

Age, Sex, NFC as control variables

### data

```{r}
full_model_data <- df_long %>%
  select(
    shared,
    structure,
    structure_num,
    motivation,
    info_distribution,
    info_importance,
    age,
    sex_num,
    need_cog_mean,
    prolific_pid,
    item_id
  ) %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(
    age_z = as.numeric(scale(age)),
    need_cog_z = as.numeric(scale(need_cog_mean))
  )
```

```{r}
full_model_data %>%
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_participants = n_distinct(prolific_pid),
    n_items = n_distinct(item_id)
  )
```

### form

```{r}
#| eval: !expr run_model

model_full <- mixed(
  shared ~
    structure_num *
    motivation *
    info_distribution *
    info_importance +
    age_z +
    sex_num +
    need_cog_z +
    (1 | prolific_pid) +
    (1 | item_id),
  data = full_model_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  method = "LRT",
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)
  )
)

saveRDS(
  model_full,
  "../artifacts/model_infosharing_full.rds"
)
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr load_artifacts

model_full <- readRDS(
   "../artifacts/model_infosharing_full.rds"
)
```

Structure: 0 = interindividual; 1 = intergroup

Motivation: Proself is reference, so motivation1 = Hybrid vs. Proself and motivation2 = Prosocial vs. Proself

Information distribution: Common is reference, so info_distribution1 = Unique vs. Common

Information importance: Low is reference, so info_importance1 = High vs. Low

Sex: 0 = male; 1 = female

```{r}
full_paper <- full_row_map %>%
  left_join(
    full_coef %>%
      select(
        coef_term,
        Estimate,
        `Std. Error`,
        OR,
        CI_low,
        CI_high
      ),
    by = "coef_term"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    full_lrt %>%
      select(
        lrt_term,
        Chisq,
        `Pr(>Chisq)`
      ),
    by = "lrt_term"
  )
```

```{r}
full_paper <- full_paper %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate_display = if_else(
      is.na(Estimate),
      "",
      format_stat(Estimate)
    ),

    SE_display = if_else(
      is.na(`Std. Error`),
      "",
      format_stat(`Std. Error`)
    ),

    LR_chisq_display = if_else(
      is.na(Chisq),
      "",
      format_stat(Chisq)
    ),

    p_display = if_else(
      is.na(`Pr(>Chisq)`),
      "",
      format_stat(`Pr(>Chisq)`, p_value = TRUE)
    ),

    OR_CI_display = if_else(
      is.na(OR),
      "",
      paste0(
        format_stat(OR),
        " [",
        format_stat(CI_low),
        ", ",
        format_stat(CI_high),
        "]"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
full_paper <- full_paper %>%
  select(
    Section,
    Predictor,
    Estimate = Estimate_display,
    SE = SE_display,
    `LR χ²` = LR_chisq_display,
    p = p_display,
    `OR [95% CI]` = OR_CI_display
  )
```

### H1c: Structure x Motivation (No Hybrid)

No interaction. Therefore, there would not be reason to look at the individual panel

```{r}
levels(df_long$motivation)
```

```{r}
# Create reduced data without the hybrid

  filter(
    motivation %in% c("Proself", "Prosocial")
  ) %>%
  droplevels()

# Verify the number of participants in each condition
h1c_data %>%
  distinct(prolific_pid, structure, motivation) %>%
  count(structure, motivation)
```

```{r}
# Any variables missing?
model_vars <- c(
  "shared",
  "structure_num",
  "motivation",
  "info_distribution",
  "info_importance",
  "age",
  "sex_num",
  "need_cog_mean",
  "prolific_pid",
  "item_id"
)

setdiff(model_vars, names(h1c_data))
```

```{r}
# Center the variables since the model prefers this
h1c_data <- h1c_data %>%
  mutate(
    sex_c = sex_num - 0.5,
    age_c = age - mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    need_cog_c = need_cog_mean - mean(need_cog_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
h1c_data %>%
  filter(
    complete.cases(

      age_c, sex_c, need_cog_c,

    )

  summarise(
    observations = n(),
    participants = n_distinct(prolific_pid),
    items = n_distinct(item_id)
  )
```

```{r}
h1c_data %>%
```

#### model

```{r}
#| eval: !expr run_model

# model
h1c_model <- afex::mixed(
  shared ~ structure * motivation *
    info_distribution * info_importance +
    age_c + sex_c + need_cog_c +
    (1 | prolific_pid) + (1 | item_id),
  data = h1c_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  method = "LRT",
  type = 3
)

# Omnibus tests
h1c_model$anova_table


saveRDS(
  h1c_model,
  "../artifacts/model_infosharing_h1c_model.rds"
  )
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr run_model

h1c_model_check <- afex::mixed(
  shared ~ structure * motivation *
    info_distribution * info_importance +
    age_c + sex_c + need_cog_c +
    (1 | prolific_pid) + (1 | item_id),

  data = h1c_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  method = "LRT",
  type = 3,

  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)
  )
)
```

```{r}
h1c_coef <- as.data.frame(
  summary(h1c_model$full_model)$coefficients
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("coef_term") %>%
  mutate(
    OR = exp(Estimate),
    CI_low = exp(Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`),
    CI_high = exp(Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`)
  )

  anova(h1c_model)
```

```{r}
# Check for names that do not match the fitted model
missing_coef <- setdiff(
  na.omit(h1c_row_map$coef_term),
  h1c_coef$coef_term
)

  na.omit(h1c_row_map$lrt_term),
  h1c_lrt$lrt_term
)

print(missing_coef)
print(missing_lrt)

if (length(missing_coef) > 0 || length(missing_lrt) > 0) {
  stop("Some coefficient or LR term names do not match the model.")
}

# Combine coefficients with LR tests
h1c_paper <- h1c_row_map %>%
  left_join(
    h1c_coef %>%
      select(
        coef_term,
        Estimate,
        `Std. Error`,
        OR,
        CI_low,
        CI_high
      ),
    by = "coef_term"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    h1c_lrt %>%
      select(
        lrt_term,
        Chisq,
        `Pr(>Chisq)`
      ),
    by = "lrt_term"
  )
```

```{r}
# format
h1c_paper <- h1c_paper %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate_display = if_else(
      is.na(Estimate),
      "",
      format_stat(Estimate)
    ),

    SE_display = if_else(
      is.na(`Std. Error`),
      "",
      format_stat(`Std. Error`)
    ),

    LR_chisq_display = if_else(
      is.na(Chisq),
      "",
      format_stat(Chisq)
    ),

    p_display = if_else(
      is.na(`Pr(>Chisq)`),
      "",
      format_stat(`Pr(>Chisq)`, p_value = TRUE)
    ),

    OR_CI_display = if_else(
      is.na(OR),
      "",
      paste0(
        format_stat(OR),
        " [",
        format_stat(CI_low),
        ", ",
        format_stat(CI_high),
        "]"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Section,
    Predictor,
    Estimate = Estimate_display,
    SE = SE_display,
    `LR χ²` = LR_chisq_display,
    p = p_display,
    `OR [95% CI]` = OR_CI_display
  )

h1c_paper
```

```{r}
write_xlsx(h1c_paper, "../tables/tables_inforsharing_h1c_paper.xlsx")
```

#### within full model

Pairwise difference in intergroup and interindividual framing

```{r}
# Estimated marginal means from the ORIGINAL model
h1c_full_emm <- emmeans(
  model_full,
  ~ motivation * structure_num
)

# Interaction contrasts
h1c_full_interactions <- contrast(
  h1c_full_emm,
  interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise")
)

summary(
  h1c_full_interactions,
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
)
```

```{r}
# Estimated marginal means from the original Study 2 model
h1c_emm <- emmeans(
  model_full,
  ~ motivation * structure_num
)

# Generate the interaction contrasts
h1c_contrasts <- contrast(
  h1c_emm,
  interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise")
)

# Retain the two comparisons specified by H1c
h1c_tests <- subset(
  as.data.frame(h1c_contrasts),
  motivation_pairwise %in% c(
    "Proself - Prosocial",
    "Hybrid - Prosocial"
  )
)

# Adjust for the two hypothesis-relevant comparisons
h1c_tests <- h1c_tests |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_holm = p.adjust(p.value, method = "holm")
  )

h1c_tests
```

comparison bewteen the two stuctures for each motivation

```{r}
# Estimate the effect of structure within each motivation condition
h1c_full_structure_emm <- emmeans(
  model_full,
  ~ structure_num | motivation
)

# Compare interindividual and intergroup within motivation
h1c_full_structure_pairs <- pairs(
  h1c_full_structure_emm,
  by = "motivation"
)

# Odds ratios, confidence intervals, and p-values
summary(
  h1c_full_structure_pairs,
  type = "response",
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
)
```

```{r}
# Motivation comparisons within each structure
h1c_full_motivation_emm <- emmeans(
  model_full,
  ~ motivation | structure_num
)

# Pairwise motivation comparisons
h1c_full_motivation_pairs <- pairs(
  h1c_full_motivation_emm,
  by = "structure_num"
)

# Odds ratios, confidence intervals, and p-values
summary(
  h1c_full_motivation_pairs,
  type = "response",
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
  adjust = "holm"
)
```

## Four panel models

##### HC

```{r}
#| eval: !expr run_model

lrt_high_common <- mixed(
  shared ~
    structure_num * motivation +
    age_z +
    sex_num +
    need_cog_z +
    (1 | prolific_pid) +
    (1 | item_id),
  data = full_model_data %>%
    filter(
      info_importance == "High",
      info_distribution == "Common"
    ),
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  method = "LRT",
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)
  )
)

saveRDS(
  lrt_high_common,
  "../artifacts/model_infosharing_lrt_high.rds"
)
```

## Simplified Model

```{r}
simple_model_data <- df_long %>%
  select(
    shared,
    structure_num,
    motivation,
    info_distribution,
    info_importance,
    need_cog_mean,
    prolific_pid,
    item_id
  ) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(
    need_cog_z = as.numeric(scale(need_cog_mean))
  )
```

```{r}
simple_model_data %>%
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_participants = n_distinct(prolific_pid),
    n_items = n_distinct(item_id)
  )
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr run_model

model_simple <- mixed(
  shared ~
    structure_num *
    motivation *
    info_distribution *
    info_importance +
    need_cog_z +
    (1 | prolific_pid) +
    (1 | item_id),
  data = simple_model_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  method = "LRT",
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)
  )
)

saveRDS(
  model_simple,
  "../artifacts/model_infosharing_simple.rds"
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Additional Processing Tables

processing_tables <- list(

  # Descriptive information
  "Sharing by Clue" = sharing_by_clue,

  "Participant Missingness" = control_missingness_participant,
  "Control Missingness" = control_missingness,

  # Control model and paper-table construction
  "Control Coefficients" = control_table,
  "Control LRT" = control_lrt,
  "Control Row Map" = control_row_map,

  # Full model and paper-table construction
  "Full Coefficients" = full_coef,
  "Full LRT" = full_lrt,
  "Full Row Map" = full_row_map,
  "Full Paper" = full_paper,

  # Estimated means table construction
  "Full EMM Original" = table_emm_full_df,
  "Full EMM Check 1" = table_emm_check1,
  "Full EMM Check 2" = table_emm_check2,
  "Full EMM Check 3" = table_emm_check3,

  # Follow-up estimated means and comparisons
  "Motivation EMM" = motivation_emm,
  "Importance EMM" = importance_emm,
  "Distribution EMM" = distribution_emm,
  "Motivation Importance EMM" = motivation_importance_emm,
  "Motivation Importance Pairs" = motivation_importance_pairs,
  "Motivation Type EMM" = motivation_by_type,
  "Motivation Type Pairs" = motivation_by_type_pairs,

  # H1a and H1b supporting tables
  "H1a EMM" = h1a_emm,
  "H1a Pairs" = h1a_pairs,
  "H1b EMM" = h1b_emm,
  "H1b Pairs" = h1b_pairs,

  # H1c supporting tables
  "H1c Row Map" = h1c_row_map,
  "H1c Interaction EMM" = h1c_interaction,
  "H1c Full EMM" = h1c_full_emm,
  "H1c Full Interaction" = h1c_full_interactions,
  "H1c Contrasts" = h1c_contrasts,
  "H1c Structure EMM" = h1c_full_structure_emm,
  "H1c Motivation EMM" = h1c_full_motivation_emm,

  # Four panel models: omnibus ANOVA tables
  "LRT High Common" = as.data.frame(anova(lrt_high_common)),
  "LRT High Unique" = as.data.frame(anova(lrt_high_unique)),
  "LRT Low Common" = as.data.frame(anova(lrt_low_common)),
  "LRT Low Unique" = as.data.frame(anova(lrt_low_unique)),

  # Four panel models: regression coefficients
  "HC Coefficients" =
    as.data.frame(summary(lrt_high_common$full_model)$coefficients),

  "HU Coefficients" =
    as.data.frame(summary(lrt_high_unique$full_model)$coefficients),

  "LC Coefficients" =
    as.data.frame(summary(lrt_low_common$full_model)$coefficients),

  "LU Coefficients" =
    as.data.frame(summary(lrt_low_unique$full_model)$coefficients)
)

# Write all processing tables to the existing workbook
for (sheet_name in names(processing_tables)) {
  wb <- save_output_to_workbook(
    sheet_name = sheet_name,
    output = processing_tables[[sheet_name]],
    wb = wb
  )
}
```
